title: A different trial collection
hook: Two stated cases: explore the evidence mix behind conflicting pooled estimates.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the evidence mix behind conflicting pooled estimates affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Pooled, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the evidence mix behind conflicting pooled estimates in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
